title: Never a jump cut, not even one frame
text: Never a jump cut, not even one frame. A cover must start on exactly the body's cut tick (v4's covers drifted 1-4 frames and flashed the jump). It must also open on a frame where the footage is fully on. Render each cover's first and last frame before building.
